name: Iron Duality
look: a black core sphere under a zigzag silver crown with glowing pink dots and cyan lightning-bolt legs, flanked by two huge dark dragon heads with gaping jaws of glowing cyan teeth
entry: A Pokémon that seems to be Regieleki and Regidrago fused into one, described in a strange article about storm clouds that roared like dragons. The core does the thinking; the two heads at its sides do the biting, and they never stop crackling.
how: Wild: very rare anywhere outdoors during a thunderstorm.
